newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. spot millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Monday but dealers noted lackluster activity despite a shortened Thanksgiving holiday week.
"Everyone wants to wait to see if there is some business coming through on the cold weather so they can raise prices," a Texas dealer said. "We had some sleet coming through."
"Nothing is going on," a Kansas dealer said. "It is very quiet.
But dealers said cold temperatures sweeping across parts of the Midwest would prompt more demand.

"There is a tendency to believe that the cold weather will prompt more demand, but it doesn't seem to be happening this morning," a Minneapolis dealer said. "I certainly think we will see firm prices."
A Buffalo dealer agreed that the market was quiet.

"It is an unusual situation for a holiday week where a lot of people will only be in for three days. But they are still not too concerned about it on a Monday. We are not looking for a great amount of run times," he said.
